content.text: Sam overhears Felix and an accomplice planning to trap the boys in a Peruvian temple. He captures the accomplice and takes him into the temple, where Jimmie and Carl are imprisoned behind an iron gate with jaguars. Sam reaches the boys through the gate and rescues them after shooting the animals. The boys discover a subterranean passage leading from the temple to the _Ann_, retrieve food and ammunition, and return through the tunnel to save Sam from attacking Indians. Later, Sam, Havens, and the boys travel by aeroplane toward the Andes fortress, where Redfern is hiding. Ben and Jimmie enter the fortress first; Havens and Sam arrive separately, are captured, then rescued when the boys turn the tables on Redfern. Redfern confesses, and the conspirators are arrested. The text then shifts to Thomas Paine’s imprisonment in Luxembourg, his release through Monroe’s intervention, his defense of reason and humane religion, and his continuing conflict with Washington and American political authorities.
